label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_01
text: Do me a favor and go home already, will ya?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_01
text: NO! I wanna see the boss of the Navi Squad!\nTake me to Don Atticus!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_02
text: Like I said, kid, the boss told me not to let any\noutsiders past these gates! That includes you![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_02
text: I don’t care! I’m not leaving till you let me talk to\nDon Atticus!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_03
text: Gimme a break, you little doofus...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_system_01
text: The people over there seem to be arguing about\nsomething... What do you want to do?

label: ajito_doku_010_select_01
text: Go say hello

label: ajito_doku_010_select_02
text: Get a little closer

label: ajito_doku_010_student_03
text: Huh?

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_04
text: Oh great. Here comes another rando to ruin\nmy day.[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_05
text: I didn’t think grunt work for Team Star newbies\nwould be this much of a chore...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_04
text: Hold on, Mr. Grunt! I think this [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]boygirl might\nbe [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wait...[VAR 0x0100(0000)]? That kid
who
picked
a
fight
with
Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_select_03
text: Yup, that’s me!

label: ajito_doku_010_select_04
text: Prepare to be raided!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_05
text: I knew it!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_07
text: Hoo-boy, this ain’t good![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_08
text: Everyone else in the base is still asleep since we\nwere up all last night playing video games...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_06
text: Leave h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer to me, Mr. Grunt! I’ll buy some time\nfor you to go wake up the others!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_09
text: Yeah? And what’s in it for you?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_07
text: Don Atticus will be in danger if no one’s here to\ndefend the base!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_08
text: I owe that man my life. He’s my dear compadre!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_09
text: And when crisis calls, one has no choice but to\nrally to those dear to him—no matter the cost!

label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_10
text: Yeah, I have no idea what you’re on about, kid.\nBut thanks for the big assist![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_10
text: All right, you villain! If you’re after Don Atticus,\nbe prepared to face my wrath!

label: ajito_doku_010_select_05
text: Bring it on

label: ajito_doku_010_select_06
text: Wait a sec!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_11
text: Discretion is the better part of valor, as the\nsaying goes. Wise choice!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_12
text: YAAAAAAH!!!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_13
text: Don Atticus...I’m sorry I failed you...

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_01
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Are you all right?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_02
text: I was standing watch when I heard a ruckus all of\na sudden.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_03
text: I got worried that maybe something had\nhappened to you over here...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_14
text: Argh... No fair! You had backup this whole time!

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_04
text: Is this boy one of the academy’s students?\nHe doesn’t look like he’s from Team Star...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_student_15
text: You’re right—I’m not a member of Team Star...\nbut Don Atticus is my compadre!

label: ajito_doku_010_student_16
text: I have to see him no matter what!

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_05
text: Well, clearly you have your reasons for\nbeing here.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I’d like to ask this
boy
some
questions.
You
go
ahead
and
get
started
on
the base.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_07
text: Might I borrow you for a chat, my, ah...my man?\nDon’t worry—I won’t bite.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
